earlierAttempt.reason: The test thread observed prepared=true before the main-thread onPrepared callback created AudioEffects. A test-only main-looper barrier now snapshots capabilities after that complete callback; production APK unchanged.

limitations: Generated silent PCM fixtures test real native state/readback, not audible or physical-frequency response.
Physical Android device and manufacturer-specific effect implementations were not tested.
Focus callbacks in audio-audit are injected into the real service; this is not physical competing-app focus QA.
Service recreation was tested; process-kill lifecycle was not.
EQ/sleep scope is native MediaPlayer only, not rooms or YouTube Music WebView.
Social notification API events use isolated fixtures; no personal account, external message or real profile change.
Checks overlap across suites; counts are reported separately.
